title: Good Afternoon
tagline: An experimental way to sign into web3. Say good afternoon to keyless accounts!
description: Good afternoon is an experimental way to sign into web3 using Account abstraction. It makes easy for new users to create a keyless account without the need for managing keys or remembering mnemonics. This reduces the risk of losing funds if the keys get leaked. It also creates a cross browser experience that makes the UX very similar to web2 apps without additional software to be installed like a browser  based wallet.
how_its_made: Good Afternoon is an experimental method for signing into Web3 using account abstraction. It simplifies the process for new users by allowing them to create a keyless account without the need to manage keys or remember mnemonics. This reduces the risk of losing funds if the keys are compromised. Additionally, it provides a cross-browser experience that makes the user experience very similar to Web2 apps, without requiring the installation of additional software like a browser-based wallet.
